scope: Object roles are separate: original initial roots are bound by ../input.json, adopted subintegrals and whole-I inputs are labelled here, comparison targets are not generation inputs. A batch may load additional moment files needed by its other members.
path_base: All paths in adopted_primitives, assembly_code and comparison_targets are relative to runtime_base.

adopted_primitives.role: Adopted evaluated moment dictionary; the kernel, branch and finite moment budget are stated in the derivation.

assembly_code.role: Expand declared evaluated mother functions and Gamma/cosh factors. TGV04 instead adopts assembled I coefficients.
Generate or adopt the stated coefficients, then compare exact representations and previous reports.
Function-coordinate arithmetic; not a new parameter integration.

comparison_targets.role: Accepted whole-I target, separate from primitive data.
